# OPC Radar
> OPC Radar is a free opportunity radar for one-person companies (OPC), indie developers, designers and cross-border sellers. It collects AI tools, GitHub repos, new products, news, deals and ideas from public sources (Hacker News, GitHub, Hugging Face, DEV, Lobsters and a curated list), translates them into 10 languages and refreshes automatically. Currently 912 items.

- Site: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/
- Data (JSON): https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/data/items.json
- Languages: zh-Hans, zh-Hant, en, ja, ko, ms, vi, fr, es, de (append ?lang=<code>)
- Publisher: Incidental AI (https://incidental.site/)
- Full list: https://siinxu.github.io/ai-opportunity-hub/llms-full.txt
- Updated: 2026-11-14T07:19:53Z
